title: refactor(ui): port the chat composer to Solid

commit.messageHeadline: refactor(ui): port chat composer rendering to Solid
ci(ui): capture composer parity and ownership proof
chore(ui): retire migrated assertion allowances
fix(ui): retain composer controls during native input
refactor(ui): isolate composer Lit compatibility boundary
fix(ui): preserve composer adapter ownership and leaf types
chore(ui): merge main for composer migration
fix(ui): align composer JSX and adapter type contracts
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into solid2/w-chat-5
fix(ui): retain composer menus during live updates
fix(ui): preserve composer refresh and emoji behavior
fix(ui): set camera mute through a typed native ref
chore(ci): remove temporary composer migration proof
fix(ui): retain mentions and publish attachment read updates
chore: merge main for composer migration
chore: integrate current main and Solid MCP imports
fix(ui): keep empty composer context out of layout
chore(ci): remove temporary composer proof workflow
chore: integrate main repair and colocate JSX tag contracts
chore(ci): retire composer migration proof workflow
build(ui): refresh composer boot module manifest
chore: integrate main guard and model settings repairs
fix(ui): type provider selection as a callback event
chore: integrate Solid chat leaf migration
fix(ui): retain composer menus and native previews
chore: integrate latest Solid panel declarations
fix(ui): keep one owner for shared element declarations
fix(ui): retain optional model controls across refreshes
chore: integrate published UI ownership repairs
build(ui): finalize composer boot module manifest
test(ui): return void from model control cleanup
test(ui): await completed menu hover transitions
chore: integrate shared session Solid components
fix(ui): preserve controls through integrated page refreshes
fix(ui): retain Activity retry button while loading
refactor(ui): join Solid palette with composer
fix(ui): isolate nested Solid composer commits
test(ui): load GitHub copy from the active hovercard renderer
ci: compare composer queue recovery against main
merge: integrate landed chat renderers
test(ui): inspect queued edit custody during recovery
fix(ui): restore queued edits without rewriting native input
ci: retire completed composer recovery proof
fix(ui): preserve composer projection and control lifetimes
merge: integrate current main context contracts
test(ui): return void from goal cleanup callback

Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR ports the shared chat composer, suggestion menus, model controls, and recovery dialogs from Lit to Solid. **Example:** A user types “hello 日本語” while an assistant response updates. - **Before:** The Lit composer preserves the native textarea and unfinished composition. - **After:** The Solid composer preserves the same input behavior through retained components. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | Strong inspected visual proof supports a useful migration, but two verified P2 findings still block approval. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected browser captures show the migrated composer in desktop conversation and empty states; linked source-pinned retention, IME, undo, and chat gates support the interaction claims. | | **Patch quality** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | 2 actionable review findings remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Refactor · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** No intended appearance or interaction change; chat and New Session must retain drafts, focus, menus, and controls during the renderer migration. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored migration follows explicit repository direction and shares the new renderers across both composers without replacing domain owners. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 2 items remain** Keep this PR open: the approved Solid migration remains necessary, but both previously reported P2 findings remain unresolved. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `ba100ae3d2dfe0991aff094dbaf5c9382dcac63c` ## Before merge - [ ] **Use the reactive translator throughout migrated presentation (P2)** - When locale publication occurs while the permission picker remains mounted, its heading and Learn more label stay in the previous language. The plain I18nManager translator registers no Solid dependency, and these expressions read no props, so even a parent refresh cannot invalidate them. Other migrated components use the same import. Use the existing translator from lib/reactive/i18n.ts in Solid presentation and cover locale publication while retaining draft, focus, and controls. This previously reported finding remains unresolved. - [ ] **Complete the suggestion-renderer ownership cutover (P2)** - Production suggestion menus now use this Solid renderer, but the overflow case in chat-composer-overflow.browser.test.tsx and the hover case in menu-surface.browser.test.ts still import the old Lit renderers from components/composer-menu.ts. Those checks can pass when the shipped Solid menu's overflow or hover behavior regresses, and they keep a second, test-only presentation implementation alive contrary to the required complete cutover. Move those cases to the Solid renderer, retain keyboard navigation as a shared plain TypeScript helper, and remove the obsolete Lit rendering functions. This previously reported finding remains unresolved. ## Findings - [P2] Use the reactive translator throughout migrated presentation — `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-permission-picker.tsx:4` - [P2] Complete the suggestion-renderer ownership cutover — `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-composer-menu.tsx:5-7`
